actions.action: Unpot plant and inspect roots and stem base for rot
Shake off wet soil and rinse roots
Cut away all soft, brown rotting tissue with sterile knife
Let plant dry 2-3 days to callous cuts
Repot in cactus/succulent mix or soil with perlite/pumice
Use a pot with drainage hole / remove from cachepot
Check soil dryness with finger or chopstick before watering
Water thoroughly when dry and empty drainage water
Place yellow sticky traps for gnats
If too far gone, cut healthy top, callous and root in dry soil
Separate and replant aloe pups if present

reason: Diagnoses root/stem rot from overwatering with mold and gnats as confirmed; the main advice to cut out the rot and repot in dry cactus mix matches the poster's fix, and nothing in it is harmful.
